_comment: Demo fixture using a CC0 photo of a kukui (candlenut) tree (samples/hotspot-2d/images/kukui-nut.jpg, Wikimedia Commons, CC0 / public domain; see packages/activities/NOTICE.md). Replace image.src with your own art for production.
title: Identify the kukui nut
prompt: This is a kukui (candlenut) tree. Click on one of the developing nuts, the round fuzzy fruits on the branch.

image.alt: A kukui (candlenut) tree branch with three round, fuzzy developing fruits among broad green leaves.

hotspots.label: Developing kukui nut
hotspots.feedback: Correct. That is a developing kukui nut, still in its fuzzy green husk.

hotspots.label: Developing kukui nut
hotspots.feedback: Correct. Inside this husk are the hard shell and the oily kukui seed.

hotspots.label: Developing kukui nut
hotspots.feedback: Correct. Kukui nuts were burned for light, which is why kukui also means light or enlightenment.

hotspots.label: Kukui leaf
hotspots.feedback: That is a kukui leaf, not the fruit. The pale, maple-like leaves are how you spot a kukui grove from a distance. Look for the round fuzzy nuts.
